Name: Anthro Shay
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This is the last of BetasEnjoyer's portraits in this little Anthro Series.

This applies Shauna's portraits and sprites from Anthro Characters Continued/ Alternate Anthro Shauna to Shay.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]It has three outfits: Spring/Fall, Summer, and Winter. The winter outfit is a combination of the fall and winter outfits shay originally has.
[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]You can choose which outfit the character wears if you like a specific outfit by setting "seasonal" to Off.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]I worked with Betasenjoyer to make some alternate facial angles. It gives this old character a little bit extra oomf.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
The base sprites were made by Gaveliere from Anthro Characters Continues, the clothing is reused and edited from Silvermoonchan's Shay Revived/rekooooon's Shane GIRL mod. All sprites and portraits were used with permission.[/color]

While I'm done with BetasEnjoyer's portraits, I plan for one more portrait for this series, at least. I'm almost there...
